board.title: QLS Lighting App — Enterprise Product Architecture & Roadmap
board.description: Consultor Luminotécnico com IA (AS/NZS 1680) + Catálogo Digital RFQ

widgets.title: Current Market Bottlenecks
widgets.content:
• Hours lost on manual Lumen/Lux calculations.
• End-clients purchasing incorrect CCT/Glare fixtures.
• High volume of redundant pre-sales technical support for factory.

widgets.title: QLS Intelligent Solution
widgets.content:
• 3-Step Guided Lighting Consultant with AS/NZS 1680 Compliance.
• Triple Option Glow Engine: Best Match, Premium & Eco.
• Instant PDF Bill of Quantities & Direct Factory RFQ Pipeline.

widgets.title: Target Personas
widgets.content:
• B2B Specifiers (Architects, Lighting Designers, Electricians).
• B2C Homeowners with room dimensions.
• QLS Factory Sales & Engineering Teams.
